title: Same Entity, Different Script: Diagnosing Cross-Script Entity Matching Failures in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.31407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multilingual language models can give different identity judgments when the same people's names are written in different scripts. We study this effect using 601 audited identity pairs with attested Devanagari and Latin forms, holding the question and relation fixed. Qwen2.5-7B's same-person accuracy falls from 35.1% in Latin to 8.5% in Devanagari under Marathi prompts, while different-person accuracy remains above 98%. Evaluation across five models reveals distinct response biases, and reduced tokenization fragmentation does not reliably close the gap. Replicating the design on 374 audited Malayalam pairs built from the same entities reproduces the effect in a second script and language family: same-person accuracy falls to 5.3%, about half the matched Devanagari rate, while the margin still ranks matching above non-matching names at 0.925 AUROC. Latin-trained probes recover label information from Devanagari states, exceeding a string-fe

translated_title: 同一实体，不同文字：诊断语言模型中的跨文字实体匹配失败
translated_abstract: 多语言语言模型在相同人名以不同文字书写时，可能会给出不同的身份判断。我们使用601对经过审核的身份配对来研究这一效应，这些配对具有经证实的天城文和拉丁文形式，并保持问题和关系固定不变。在马拉地语提示下，Qwen2.5-7B的同一人判断准确率从拉丁文的35.1%降至天城文的8.5%，而不同人判断的准确率保持在98%以上。对五个模型的评估揭示了各自不同的响应偏差，且减少分词碎片化并不能可靠地缩小这一差距。在使用由相同实体构建的374对经过审核的马拉雅拉姆语配对复制该实验设计时，该效应在第二种文字和语系中得到复现：同一人判断准确率降至5.3%，约为匹配的天城文比例的一半，而其区分度仍以0.925的AUROC将匹配姓名排在非匹配姓名之上。用拉丁文训练的探针可以从天城文的内部状态中恢复标签信息，超过了字符串（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 语言模型判断不同文字书写的同一人名是否为同一人的能力存在巨大差距，同一人判断准确率从拉丁文的35.1%骤降至天城文的8.5%和马拉雅拉姆语的5.3%，该效应在多个模型、两种文字和语系中均存在，且无法通过减少分词碎片化来弥补。
en_tdlr: Language models dramatically fail to recognize that the same person's name written in different scripts (Devanagari, Malayalam vs. Latin) refers to the same identity, with same-person accuracy dropping to as low as 5.3%, an effect persisting across models and language families that cannot be explained by tokenization fragmentation.
